questions.q: How many trained servants did Abram arm to rescue Lot?
questions.explain: He divided his men and moved by night; with them and his confederates he smote four kingdoms. Abram was a warrior.

questions.q: Where does the victory of battle come from, according to the precepts read?
choices: From the size of the army
From heaven; the battle is not yours but God's
questions.explain: The victory of battle standeth not in the multitude of an host (1 Maccabees 3:18-19); the battle is God's (2 Chronicles 20:15).

choices: One of the four Mesopotamian kings
King of Salem, the king of peace, and priest of the Most High God
questions.explain: Abram paid tithes to him, way before the Levitical priesthood.

questions.q: Why did Abram refuse the goods the king of Sodom offered?
choices: He had taken a vow of poverty
He gave them all to Melchizedek
Lest the king of Sodom say, I have made Abram rich
questions.explain: He refused from a thread even to a shoelatchet; the young men who fought still took their portion.
